phases:

      - aws ecr get-login-password --region us-east-1 | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin 020033178044.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com

      - docker push 020033178044.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/vibe:latest
